name: away-mode
description: Claude messages you in Microsoft Teams when it needs you while you're away, and your replies go straight back into the session.

tenant_id.title: Tenant ID
tenant_id.description: Your Microsoft 365 tenant ID. setup\install.ps1 fills this in; otherwise it's printed by setup/create-app.

bot_app_id.title: Bot app ID
bot_app_id.description: The Away Mode bot's app ID. setup\install.ps1 fills this in; otherwise it's printed by setup/create-app.

bot_secret.title: Bot secret
bot_secret.description: The Away Mode bot's secret. setup\install.ps1 fills this in without showing it. Stored in your OS keychain, never in settings files.

away_hours.title: Default away length (hours)
away_hours.description: How long away mode lasts when you don't say.

wait_minutes.title: Wait for a reply (minutes)
wait_minutes.description: How long Claude waits for your reply before the end-of-day action applies.

end_of_day_action.title: When there's no reply
end_of_day_action.description: park = pause the task and wait for you. safest = continue with the safest option and tell you.

never_relay.title: Terminal-only commands
never_relay.description: Comma-separated command patterns that can only be approved at the terminal, never from Teams.

bun_path.title: Bun path
bun_path.description: Full path to bun (bun.exe on Windows). setup\install.ps1 fills this in so Away Mode works even before your terminal picks up a new PATH. Leave as bun if it's on your PATH.
